description:
While trying to hide the fact that he’s an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn’t use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold…until Brett takes things one step too far.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/unpleasant)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/scent), [Japanese](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/huyukai), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/unpleasant), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/unpleasant), [German](https://www.lezhinde.com/detail/dbd_00326), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/bt_1110954), [Spanish](https://www.lezhin.es/detail/un-aroma-inquietante)

##### Notes:   
##### \-This series was originally a [6-chapter short story](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/di8sbod/an-unsettling-scent), but the author decided to continue it over a year after it was completed. After the 2nd season it was announced, that the story will conclude in 3 seasons.

##### \-The T.Chinese version became fully uncensored after file replacement.      
      
##### \-All official translations are uncensored, except for German and Japanese.
